characters.continuity: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
characters.summary: Calamity Ganon is a primal, malevolent force of destruction capable of unleashing immense malice, elemental energy attacks, and possessing mechanical guardians. It fights primarily at range using concentrated beams and energy projections before manifesting a physical beast form.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to the Bow of Light and sacred arrows
limitations: Trapped within a cocoon for recovery after initial defeat by Zelda
Requires possession of technology or minions to project influence widely

sources.supports: Combat techniques, cocoon phase, and weaknesses against sacred light.

feats.claim: Corrupted the ancient Guardian units and Divine Beasts across Hyrule.
feats.citation: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild (Prologue / Backstory)

feats.claim: Survived for a century inside a cocoon of Malice regenerating its health.
feats.citation: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild (Climax)

notableResults.citation: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild (Boss Battle)
notableResults.note: Defeated after Link weakened its beast form and Zelda used her sealing power.

campaignTags.claim: Manifests ancient dark magic and Malice to attack and corrupt technology.

unknowns: The exact upper limit of its durability outside the Malice cocoon.

characters.continuity: Super Smash Bros. series / F-Zero series
characters.summary: Captain Falcon is an aggressive, high-speed hand-to-hand brawler who relies on explosive physical strikes, fiery melee attacks, and his high-speed racing vehicle, the Blue Falcon.
weaknesses: Vulnerable during recovery frames of high-commitment attacks like the Falcon Punch
limitations: Melee-focused range outside of vehicle usage
High recovery time on missed signature attacks

sources.supports: Moveset, physical brawling style, and special techniques.

feats.claim: Delivered a devastating fiery punch capable of projecting a massive phoenix of flame.

campaignTags.claim: Generates localized intense fire during the Falcon Punch strike.
Drives and pilots the Blue Falcon racing machine.

unknowns: Extent of his bounty hunting combat feats outside of racing and crossover brawls.

characters.summary: Charizard is a dual Fire and Flying-type dragon-like Pokémon that fights using intense thermal blasts, physical claw strikes, and aerial maneuverability.
weaknesses: Weakness to Electric and Rock-type attacks
limitations: Tail flame indicates health and emotional state; extinguishing it can be fatal
Vulnerable to stealth rock hazards

sources.supports: Types, natural abilities, moveset, and weaknesses.

feats.claim: Melts boulders and thick ice with flames hot enough to melt anything.
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Pokédex entries

campaignTags.claim: Generates and controls intense fire from its mouth and tail.
Possesses large wings capable of sustained natural flight.

unknowns: Specific upper temperature limits of unevolved base form flames.

characters.summary: Gigantamax Charizard transforms into a towering, multi-story spectral fire monster capable of unleashing unique G-Max wildfire attacks that trap opponents.

mechanisms: Massive physical scale and HP pool

weaknesses: Vulnerable to Water, Electric, and Rock attacks
Form duration is strictly limited to three turns
limitations: Form reverts automatically after three turns
Can only be used in specific locations with Dynamax energy
characters.formDifferences: Grows to giant size, replaces standard moves with Max and G-Max variants, and changes wings into blazing spectral energy.

sources.supports: Gigantamax attributes, G-Max Wildfire, and form limitations.

feats.claim: Engulfs opponents in columns of fire that burn continuously for multiple turns.

conditional.dependsOn: Dynamax Band and Power Spot energy

campaignTags.claim: Creates towering pillars of G-Max spectral fire.
Grows to massive proportions through Gigantamax energy.
Maintains flight using wings composed entirely of concentrated flame.

unknowns: Exact structural integrity of the flame wings against high-pressure water.

characters.summary: Mega Charizard X turns into a Fire and Dragon-type with black-and-blue scales, venting blue flames from its jaws and gaining massive physical combat capability.

mechanisms: Tough Claws ability enhancing physical contact moves

weaknesses: Vulnerable to Dragon, Ground, and Rock attacks
limitations: Requires Charizardite X to transform
Reverts upon fainting or battle conclusion
characters.formDifferences: Changes typing from Fire/Flying to Fire/Dragon, alters color scheme to black and blue, and shifts combat focus from special attacks to physical prowess.

sources.supports: Mega Charizard X typing, ability, and stat changes.

feats.claim: Increased its physical power dramatically, turning its fire blue due to higher temperatures.

conditional.dependsOn: Charizardite X item and Trainer bond

campaignTags.claim: Exhales scorching blue flames from the sides of its mouth.
Retains powered flight using modified wings.

unknowns: How long it can maintain maximum output without resting.

characters.summary: Mega Charizard Y enhances its original typing with the Drought ability, instantly summoning intense sunlight to power up its fire attacks and aerial speed.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to Rock, Water, and Electric attacks
limitations: Requires Charizardite Y to transform
Vulnerable to weather-clearing counters
characters.formDifferences: Retains Fire/Flying type, gains sharper horns and sleek wings, and vastly increases special attack capability and speed.

sources.supports: Mega Charizard Y stats, Drought ability, and special attack prowess.

feats.claim: Flew at speeds capable of rivaling jet fighters while generating intense sunlight.

conditional.dependsOn: Charizardite Y item and Trainer bond

campaignTags.claim: Channels immense solar energy to fire instant solar beams and hyper-heated flames.
Features streamlined horns and wings optimized for blistering flight speed.

unknowns: Limits of thermal output under extreme opposing weather conditions.

characters.summary: Chell is a resilient test subject who uses the Aperture Science Handheld Portal Device to solve complex spatial puzzles, redirect energy, and outmaneuver robotic foes.
weaknesses: Standard human physical durability outside of boots
Relies entirely on portal-conductive surfaces for portal placement
limitations: Cannot place portals on non-conductive surfaces
Physically ordinary human without specialized gear

sources.supports: Equipment, Long Fall Boots, and portal gun mechanics.

feats.claim: Survived falls from extreme heights using Long Fall Boots.
Defeated GLaDOS and Wheatley using clever portal placement and environmental hazards.

notableResults.note: Destroyed her personality cores using the incinerator.
Used a portal to shoot a portal onto the Moon, venting Wheatley into space.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes the Aperture Science Handheld Portal Device.
Creates connected spatial doorways using the portal gun.

unknowns: What happened to her after leaving the Aperture facility.

characters.summary: Chrono is a silent swordsman who wields katanas and combines physical strikes with lightning magic and time-spatial distortion techniques.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to magic suppression and heavy status ailments
limitations: Limited MP pool for magic casting
Relies primarily on close-quarters melee range

sources.supports: Swordsmanship, lightning magic capabilities, and techniques.

feats.claim: Traveled through multiple distinct eras of history to defeat Lavos.

notableResults.note: Defeated the planetary parasite across time with his companions.

campaignTags.claim: Summons and projects natural lightning and electrical bolts in combat.
Wields innate magical power tied to time and elements.

unknowns: Exact mechanics of his temporal manipulation outside of time gates and pendants.

characters.summary: Chun-Li is an Interpol martial artist renowned for her peerless leg speed, acrobatic aerial maneuvers, and signature projectile energy blasts.
weaknesses: Limited range against heavy projectile zoners
limitations: Human physical limits
Requires close or moderate distance to execute punishing combos

sources.supports: Martial arts background, Kikoken, and Lightning Kick techniques.

feats.claim: Delivered dozens of rapid kicks in seconds, overwhelming seasoned fighters.

notableResults.note: Overpowered during her quest for revenge, though she later assists in dismantling Shadaloo.

unknowns: The precise internal ki mechanics behind her Kikoken energy density.

characters.summary: Ciri is a Child of the Elder Blood capable of instantaneous teleportation, spatial dashing, and wielding a steel sword with lethal precision.
weaknesses: Human physical durability if caught mid-action
Emotions can cause erratic and uncontrolled outbursts of Elder Blood power
limitations: Cannot maintain continuous long-range teleportation without fatigue
Melee weapon range

sources.supports: Elder Blood abilities, teleportation blink, and swordsmanship.

feats.claim: Flipped across battlefields and phased through enemy defenses using rapid spatial blinks.

notableResults.note: Defeated the King of the Wild Hunt in single combat.

campaignTags.claim: Channels ancient Elder Blood magic to warp space.
Teleports short distances instantly in combat.

unknowns: The full extent of her capability to travel across different dimensions without external aid.
